articles.summary: As workflows grow more sophisticated, teams need tools that make it easy to build, iterate, and maintain decisioning logic over time. That’s why we’ve introduced Branch Reconnection and Reusable Paths in Data Orchestration: a feature designed to help teams create workflows faster while keeping them clean and easy to understand.
articles.title: New at Lendflow: Simplifying Data Orchestration with Branch Reconnection and Reusable Paths

articles.summary: We’re proud to share that Lendflow has been named “LendTech of the Year” in the 2026 FinTech Breakthrough Awards, an honor that recognizes some of the most innovative companies shaping the future of financial technology.

articles.summary: As we prepare to close out Q1, we’ve got a lot to share this month at Lendflow.
